newsitem.title: USA: Ford adds 30,000 units to Q3 output plan.
newsitem.headline: Ford adds 30,000 units to Q3 output plan.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. said Tuesday it would boost its third quarter North American production schedule by 30,000 vehicles as a result of strong July sales results and a favorable economic outlook.

The 30,000-unit addition will consist of 15,000 cars and 15,000 trucks, Ford said. With the extra units, Ford now intends to produce 988,000 vehicles during the third quarter of 1997, including 393,000 cars and 595,000 trucks.

Ford reported that its total vehicle sales -- including heavy trucks -- during the month of July increased 5 percent to 357,058, its highest July total since 1978. Ford's truck sales for July were up 14 percent, while car sales were off 5.4 percent.
